crewNotes.text: General Sri Lanka traveller allowances (tourist category); crew should confirm crew-specific treatment. Compiled from the cited Sri Lanka Customs guide, pending final authority review.

rules.text: Tourists may bring in up to 2 regular bottles of wine and up to 1.5 litres of spirits duty-free.

declarationRequirements.text: The duty-free goods allowance depends on length of stay - for stays under 90 days it is about USD 187.50 (duty-free shop). Foreign currency and gold jewellery must be declared to the Customs Arrival officer.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.
